potd: GAME DAY PROCESS applies: Game Day Why block, matchup rank (≤20 preferred) and the hard vetoes.
Volume potd: one POTD per sport bubble when that sport has games. Hard Rock price -105 to -135 at selection. No edge requirement (POTD and POTD #n).
Filters: the Alt Line Parlay volume filter and eligible-player rules and bans, plus hit rate at that exact line of at least 7 of last 10, with 8+ of last 10 preferred (the only hit-rate test).
The card carries a "Volume" stamp. The Majors/Today POTD is the best of the Big 4 sport POTDs (NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB).
The official standards still applies: locked only from the morning prop scan, no near-miss or filler, and no POTD at all on a day LineMate data is missing or signed out.
Price drift: a POTD only has to be in band at selection. Later moves of any size never void it. Void only for inactive player or postponed/cancelled game.
A provisional pick that is out of band before lock with no in-band replacement is marked "On hold" and re-checked at lock. It still never voids for drift.

POTD auto-chain: when a sport's POTD settles, a staged pick posts as "POTD #n" (official, locked). Candidates meet the same filters, are pregame with at least 10 min to start, use no game already used by the chain, are in band, and pass a final live Hard Rock check. Nothing qualifies, nothing posts. All Sports POTD does NOT chain. The newest chain pick shows alone in the card.
Every POTD locks when posted at the 7 AM ET publish. A POTD player ruled out before his game is swapped or voided per.
parlay100: Game day process applies to every leg: Game Day Why block, matchup rank (≤20 preferred) and the hard vetoes.

Volume parlay: 2-3 legs. Legs may be ANY real Hard Rock line: a player prop OR a game line (spread, total, moneyline, team total), main or alt, at any price (no per-leg range). No edge requirement. The eligible-prop list does not limit Parlay +100 legs.

Filters: player-prop legs pass the volume/role filter and bans (no TDs, longest-play, blocks/steals, pitcher Ks, hitter unders, questionable players) and hit that exact line in 7+ of the player's last 10. Game-line legs need the team/game to have hit that line in 7+ of its last 10. 7+ of last 10 is the only hit-rate test.

Chain: a parlay that settles (L as soon as any leg loses) is followed by "Parlay +100 #n" built to the same rules, combined +100 to +140, using no game from an earlier parlay that day. The All Sports (Big 4) parlay chains too.
Same-game rule: legs normally come from different games. When only ONE game is on the slate or left, the ticket is built as a same-game parlay PREGAME.
All Sports parlay: safest 2-4 legs, about +100 to +115. Official. Must use different legs and cannot be a pure copy of a sport parlay.
Code note: the bot and the bot still carry old Parlay +100 price-range checks (-500..+120 and the PRICE RANGE ERROR); they must match this section.
edge: Hard Rock price vs Pinnacle no-vig fair. Edge % = EV% at Hard Rock price. Ranked by edge %. Each pick is locked once posted.
ONE PASS, NO FILLER: Edge runs one pass and posts only plays that qualify. Nothing is filled. This supersedes COUNT's "at least 3" and ALWAYS FILL below.
Qualifying threshold: positive EV at the Hard Rock price, about -130 or better, Pinnacle prices both sides of the same line.

Grade: every Edge play shows a letter grade A..C on line 1 of its row, with the reason in its Why. Player props blend the edge % with a hit-rate model from real recent logs (last 10 + season); game lines and props with no log grade on price, max B+. Thin markets (alts, periods, 3-way) cap at B; fill plays below the bar cap at C+. Grades are display/strength only; ranking stays by edge %.

Display: Edge box collapsed shows only its play count until opened. Empty labels: "No Edge plays qualified today" when the slate has games and nothing qualified; "No games today" only when there are no games.
lotto: Official. Exempt from the official standards's edge rule (no Pinnacle edge requirement) and from the parlay shape, same as The Heist. Everything else still applies: real Hard Rock prices only (else a real price from another book, labeled Hard Rock unverified), never invent a price, locks, grading.

heist: The Heist is a daily Official parlay built from the cappers' own picks, each bought down to a shorter real Hard Rock alt rung.

No lineup/injury rules: The Heist is strictly the cappers' plays converted down. Lineup and injury rules do not apply to it: no injury, inactive, matchup or lineup swaps on Heist legs, and "Questionable = out", Swaps, projected lineups, projected starters and replacements do not apply. A leg whose player does not play is settled under Grading below (void or DNP stays Pending until settled by hand).

Exempt from the official standards's edge rule (no Pinnacle edge requirement) and from the parlay shape. Everything else still applies: real Hard Rock prices only, never invent a price, locks, grading.

Ticket: max 5 legs, one per game, at least 2 legs. With no ticket yet (before the first build, or fewer than 2 bought-down legs) the card is a minimal empty card: header, Stake 1u and this Rules dropdown, with no timing text.

TALLY = INDIVIDUAL ALT PROPS: every buy-down in the Buy-downs list is its own Official 1u single, graded at its converted Hard Rock alt line (the capper's original line when no rung was kept), priced at that Hard Rock alt price (kept line: the real Hard Rock exact-line price before kickoff, else the capper's posted price). Rows are written to the bot once the game starts (conversion frozen at kickoff) and graded nightly by the bot (W pays at the price, L = -1u, push/void 0; longest rush/rec from the ESPN box-score LONG column). Not graded (not a single prop with a gradable line): capper parlays, ML/side picks and ambiguous stats; the card lists each with its reason. Every buy-down row and every leg shows the live prop tracker at the active book's converted line.

CAPPER SELF-AUDIT. The bot runs automatically, zero LLM, in every capper pull path: the 7 AM pull and every the bot run (7am, 10am, 1230pm, 4pm), in this order: the bot, then a pre-audit that fixes rows (result not gating), then the bot, then the bot, then the GATE audit against the freshly built the bot, then push. It does four things.
allofficial: Top-level groups [AMENDED 2026-10-28 6:16 AM ET: was "Exactly three groups"]: Official, Alt Parlay / Safe +100, Edge, and Cappers (capper picks, tracking only). No other group, tier or label exists anywhere on the dashboard.

The official standards stay in force for every Official pick: the morning prop scan only, NHL shot-over minimums, no fill. The 4% Pinnacle edge applies only to Edge and LEG DAY. POTD and Parlay +100 have no edge requirement and qualify on volume/role and recent hit rate instead. Exemptions: The Heist, Lotto Ticket / TD City and Safe +100 / Alt Parlay, each with its own rules in its section.

A former box that cannot meet the official standards is DROPPED, not converted: Runners-up, ALT LINES (sport and Big 4 cards), Home Field, NRFI and inning calls, Live POTD / Live Parlay, Live top lines, in-game lines and the NASCAR extra list. Their scripts no longer run from the bot.
Official history from before this order (POTD, Parlay +100, our recommended legs, Edge) is unchanged. No backfill, except the Lotto Ticket / TD City and Safe +100 / Alt Parlay history restored.

Strict readings: near-misses, fillers and model-only edges are not posted at all; Edge counts as Official, so Pinnacle 4% and NO FILL apply to Edge too; capper picks are idea sources tracked in Cappers only, never in the Official headline; live plays stay untracked; the NCAA F section keeps its separate record.
legday: What: a daily ranked Official board of up to 10 player props per sport at real Hard Rock prices -105 to -135, main or alt line. It replaces the old leg-by-leg Legs tracker.

Gates (every prop): at least 4% edge against the Pinnacle no-vig fair price. When Pinnacle has no price, the projection must be at least 8% past the line (LEG DAY only; it does not extend to any other ticket).
Game day process applies: Game Day Why block, matchup rank (≤22 preferred for LEG DAY) and the hard vetoes.
Source: only the morning prop scan, built on the full LineMate pull. No hand picks.
Role confirmed. Questionable players are out.
Ranking score: Edge 45, LineMate hit rate 25 (L5 weighted heaviest), matchup 15, role stability 10, news and line movement 5.
Board: numbered 1-10 by score. Stake: flat 1u per prop, shown in units only.
NFL: snap, target and rush share plus red-zone role. Healthy players post at the 7 AM ET publish; a player ruled inactive before kickoff is swapped.
NBA and WNBA: minutes and usage; usage bumps from injuries count positive; rest, back-to-backs and blowout risk count negative.
NCAAF: the NFL factors, stable depth charts only.
NASCAR: H2H or top-10/top-20 finish, using practice, qualifying and track history.
Holds: LEG DAY uses individual player holds only (a held prop holds alone; the board is not held as a whole).
Replacements: any replacement meets the same standard as the original pick.
Grading: nightly, each prop as a 1u single at its locked price; only final games are graded, never guessed.
